assessment.message: No England-wide current environmental assessment is published because the governed monitoring coverage and freshness gate was not met.

claim_boundary: Screening evidence only — no source attribution, causal finding, permit-breach determination, exposure estimate or health conclusion.

convergence.message: No episode was available for corroboration. Cross-source convergence was not applicable to an episode in this run.

catalogued_candidate_sites.definition: Provider or catalogue site identities considered before physical-site resolution and current-value checks.
catalogued_candidate_sites.label: catalogued candidate monitoring-site identities

eligible_pm25_screening_assessments.definition: PM2.5 station/time-series assessments meeting the current freshness, completeness and quality criteria.
eligible_pm25_screening_assessments.label: eligible PM2.5 screening assessments

england_active_aurn_sites.definition: Active English AURN sites discovered for the completed 30-day official-monitoring review.
england_active_aurn_sites.label: active English AURN sites discovered

england_configured_review_stations.definition: English AURN stations configured for at least one review pollutant in the 30-day review.
england_configured_review_stations.label: configured pollutant-monitor stations

england_expected_configured_pollutant_da.definition: Configured station/pollutant streams multiplied by eligible days in the review window.
england_expected_configured_pollutant_da.label: expected configured pollutant-day observations

england_reporting_review_stations.definition: Configured English AURN stations contributing at least one valid daily mean during the review period.
england_reporting_review_stations.label: reporting stations in the 30-day review

england_unique_station_days.definition: Distinct station/date pairs contributing at least one valid pollutant daily mean.
england_unique_station_days.label: unique station-days with valid evidence

england_valid_pollutant_day_observations.definition: Valid station/date/pollutant daily-mean rows in the England 30-day review.
england_valid_pollutant_day_observations.label: valid pollutant-day observations

fresh_physical_sites.definition: Resolved physical sites with at least one usable observation inside the declared freshness window.

fresh_pollutant_streams.definition: Configured streams with recent usable observations inside the declared freshness window.
fresh_pollutant_streams.label: fresh pollutant time series

numeric_reporting_sites.definition: Resolved physical sites with at least one numeric observation in the current provider response.
numeric_reporting_sites.label: resolved physical sites returning numeric data

numeric_reporting_streams.definition: Configured streams with at least one numeric observation in the current provider response.
numeric_reporting_streams.label: pollutant time series returning numeric data

resolved_physical_sites.definition: Distinct physical monitoring locations after governed site-identity reconciliation.
resolved_physical_sites.label: resolved physical monitoring sites

denominators.rule: Every public percentage must name one numerator key and one denominator key from this registry.

england_30_day_review.data_posture: provisional and ratified official AURN automatic measurements, status flags preserved

definitions.configured_stream_day_completeness: Valid pollutant-day observations divided by expected configured pollutant-day observations.
definitions.unique_station_day: One distinct station/date pair with at least one valid pollutant daily mean.
definitions.who_context_pollutant_day_observation: A valid pollutant-day observation above the pollutant-specific WHO 2021 24-hour contextual reference; not a UK legal exceedance.

england_30_day_review.provisional_status_public_label: Official automatic monitoring data are provisional or as supplied unless explicitly marked ratified and may later be revised by the original provider.

count_definitions.analysis_excluded_observation_count: Downloaded numeric observations excluded from the analysis window or project quality rules.
count_definitions.analysis_window_valid_observation_count: Quality-accepted numeric observations inside the exact analysis window.
count_definitions.physical_site_count: Canonically resolved physical monitoring locations; pollutant streams and unresolved provider identities are not counted as additional physical sites.
count_definitions.provider_expected_slot_count: Provider records or timetable slots represented by the canonical monitoring snapshot.
count_definitions.provider_missing_slot_count: Represented provider slots without a numeric observation; zero where the source does not supply an explicit missing-slot timetable.
count_definitions.provider_numeric_observation_count: Timestamped numeric provider observations in the canonical monitoring snapshot.
count_definitions.provider_site_identity_count: Provider site identities before canonical physical-site resolution; retained only as a separate network-availability denominator.
count_definitions.reporting_physical_site_count: Canonically resolved physical sites with at least one quality-accepted observation inside the current analysis window.
count_definitions.reporting_provider_site_identity_count: Provider site identities returning numeric data before canonical physical-site resolution.
count_definitions.timeseries_count: Unique monitoring streams defined by source, station, pollutant, method, unit and averaging period.

freshness_diagnostic.claim_boundary: This diagnostic concerns data recency and provider/network timing only. It does not describe air quality, source contribution, compliance, exposure or health risk.
freshness_diagnostic.interpretation: Some reporting sites met the freshness threshold and others did not.

primary_source.geographic_scope: official UK-AIR monitoring selected for England Phase 1
primary_source.name: Defra UK-AIR Sensor Observation Service

programme.coverage_scope: official UK-AIR monitoring selected for England Phase 1

release.public_wording: Acquisition status distinguishes primary monitoring evidence from mandatory contextual sources. A degraded context harvest may support a clearly labelled data-availability release, but not an environmental episode, source, compliance, exposure or health finding. No England-wide current environmental assessment is published because the governed monitoring coverage and freshness gate was not met. No episode was available for corroboration. Cross-source convergence was not applicable to an episode in this run.
